name: Wandering in Space
source:
This is a short, futuristic visual novel, that tells the story of one young man who wanders against their will, in the newest space ship to overpopulation to another planet. The action takes place in space, in time of war.

Find out the end of this story...

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/731730/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部短篇未来主义视觉小说，讲述一名年轻男子违背意愿，在最新型宇宙飞船上被送往另一颗行星，以解决人口过剩问题。故事发生在战争时期的太空中。

找出故事的结局……

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/731730/]Steam[/url]]
